SOUTH GATE PLANNING COMMISSION
  REGULAR PC AGENDA

  Tuesday, December 2, 2025 at 6:30 p.m.

  SOUTH GATE COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  8650 CALIFORNIA AVENUE
  SOUTH GATE, CA 90280
1.  Call To Order
2.  Pledge of Allegiance
3.  Roll Call
4.  City Officials
  CHAIRPERSON  COMMISSIONERS
  Lizette Ruiz  Mayra Castaneda
  Jimmy Ozaeta
  VICE CHAIRPERSON  Margarita Valenzuela
  Daisy Prieto

5.  Report On Posting
  I, Javier Barraza, Special Projects Coordinator, certify that a true and correct copy of the foregoing
  meeting agenda was properly posted on November 26, 2025, seventy-two hours prior to the
  scheduled meeting, as required by law.

6.  Meeting Compensation Disclosure
  Pursuant to Government Code Section 54952.3: Disclosure of compensation for meeting
  attendance by the Planning Commission is $125.00 per meeting.

7.  Consent Calendar
  Business items, except those formally noticed for public hearing or require discussion, are placed in
  the Consent Calendar. Any Commissioner may request that any Consent Calendar item(s) be
  removed, discussed, and acted upon separately. Items remaining on the Consent Calendar will be
  approved in one motion unless another action is taken. The Chair will call on anyone wishing to
  address the Commission on any Consent Calendar item, which has not been pulled for discussion.

  1
   A.  PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES FOR NOVEMBER 18, 2025
  The Planning Commission will consider approval of the minutes for the Regular
  Planning Commission meeting of November 18, 2025.

  Documents:

  PC Minutes 11.18.25.pdf

8.  Public Hearings
  Public hearings are those items formally noticed under the requirements of South Gate Municipal
  Code Section 11.50.020. The Planning Commission shall hold a public hearing and make required
  findings to either approve, approve with conditions, or deny an application by adopting a resolution.

9.  Open Session Items
  Open session items are intended to be discussed by the Planning Commission but do not require a
  public hearing. These include presentations, trainings, and workshops.

  A.  1. City's Budget and Fiscal Future
  A presentation will be made on the City’s budget and fiscal future, which is based on
  one made to the City Council on November 11, 2025.

  Documents:

  AB_City's_Budget_and_Fiscal_Future_120225_F.pdf

10. Comments
  At this time, members of the public and staff may address the City Planning Commission regarding
  any items within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Planning Commission. No action may be
  taken on items not listed on the agenda unless authorized by law.

  A. AUDIENCE COMMENTS

  B. CITY STAFF COMMENTS

  C. PLANNING COMMISSION COMMENTS

11. Adjournment

  In compliance with the American with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
  in the Planning Commission meeting, please contact Community Development Department.
  Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the City to make reasonable arrangements to
  assure accessibility.

  All of the above resolutions and zoning case items have been determined to be categorically
  exempt pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines unless otherwise
  stated.

  Any final action of the Planning Commission, on this agenda, is appealable to the City Council upon
  filling the request with the City Clerk prior to 5:00 p.m. on Thursday, December 18, 2025.

  Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the Planning Commission after distribution

  2
 of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the Community Development
Department, 8650 California Ave., South Gate, CA 90280. For more information, call (323) 563-
9565 or visit the City's website at www.cityofsouthgate.org.

  3
   ACTION MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  OF THE SOUTH GATE CITY PLANNING COMMISSION
  TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 18, 2025

  1. CALL TO ORDER – 6:32 p.m.
  The Planning Commission of the City of South Gate met in-person on November 18, 2025, at 6:32
  p.m., Chair Ruiz presiding.

  2. PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
  Vice Chair Prieto led the Pledge of Allegiance.

  3. ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present:  Chairperson Lizette Ruiz
  Vice Chairperson Daisy Prieto
  Commissioner Jimmy Ozaeta
  Commissioner Mayra Castaneda

  Commissioner Absent:  Commissioner Margarita Valenzuela [absent during Roll
  Call]

  4. CITY OFFICIALS

  Staff Present:  Gabriel Perez, Community Development Director
  John F. Signo, AICP, Planning Manager
  Craig Hardwick, Assistant City Attorney
  Joshua Valdez, Associate Planner
  Javier Barraza, Special Projects Coordinator

  5. REPORT ON POSTING
  Special Projects Coordinator Barraza certified the meeting agenda was properly posted.

  6. MEETING COMPENSATION DISCLOSURE
  Special Projects Coordinator Barraza disclosed the Commissioners’ compensation.

Planning Commission Minutes 11.18.25
  Page 1 of 5  4
   7. CONSENT CALENDAR
  A. PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES FOR OCTOBER 21, 2025
  The Planning Commission considered approval of the minutes for the Regular Planning
  Commission meeting of October 21, 2025.

  B. PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES FOR NOVEMBER 4, 2025
  The Planning Commission considered approval of the minutes for the Regular Planning
  Commission meeting of November 4, 2025.

  Action: Approved 4-0.
  Motion by Vice Chair Prieto to approve the minutes for October 21,
  2025, and November 4, 2025.
  Seconded by Commissioner Casteneda.

  COMMISSIONER  VOTE
  Castaneda  Yes
  Ozaeta  Yes
  Valenzuela  Absent
  Vice-Chairperson Prieto  Yes
  Chairperson Ruiz  Yes
  [Vice Chairperson Prieto recused herself at 6:36 p.m. before Item 8.A.]

  8. PUBLIC HEARING
  A. CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT (CUP) NO.25-03 FOR A MEDICAL AND DENTAL OFFICE FACILITY
  WITH URGENT CARE SERVICES WITHIN AN EXISTING COMMERCIAL BUILDING AT 4433 AND
  4437 TWEEDY BOULEVARD, AND FINDING THE ACTION EXEMPT FROM THE CALIFORNIA
  ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ACT.

  Planning Manager Signo gave an overview of the item and introduced Associate Planner Valdez,
  who provided a presentation.

  Staff recommended that the Planning Commission:

  1. Find that in accordance with CEQA, this project qualifies for a categorical exemption
  under CEQA Guidelines Section 15301, (Class 1) “Existing Facilities” and Section 15332,
  (Class 32) “In-Fill Development,” and is thereby exempt from CEQA in that the project
  consists only of improvements to existing structures with no expansions being proposed,
  and is surrounded by urban uses.

  2. Adopt Resolution No. 2025-11 approving CUP No. 25-03.

  [Commissioner Valenzuela joined the meeting during staff’s presentation at 6:44 p.m.]

  Applicant Ben Borukhim thanked staff and stated the architect and owner were available for
  questions.

Planning Commission Minutes 11.18.25
  Page 2 of 5  5
   Written Comments:

    Mario Dominguez Jr.
    Los Angeles Unified School District (LAUSD)

  Commissioner Ozaeta asked if staff proactively contacts the school district.

  Planning Manager Signo responded that notices are sent to owners and occupants within 1,000
  feet of the subject property, and that the School District did receive a notice.

  Assistant City Attorney Hardwick indicated construction impacts are addressed using best
  management practices.

  Planning Manager Signo indicated that the renovation and reuse of an existing building is exempt
  from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA).

  Chairperson Ruiz commented about the use and parking.

  Commissioner Ozaeta asked about the traffic memo.

  Assistant City Attorney Hardwick explained there is an infill development exception under CEQA.

  Commissioner Ozaeta asked about a larger water meter and Planning Manager Signo responded.

  Chairperson Ruiz asked about the mural and Assistant City Attorney Hardwick provided an
  explanation.

  Chairperson Ruiz asked about parking and stated it should be discussed by the City Council.

  Commissioner Ozaeta asked the applicant about the services that will be provided.

  Property Owner and Applicant Jack Azad described the services.

  Commissioner Valenzuela asked about LAUSD’s letter.

  Assistant City Attorney indicated the City may consider the concerns.

  Planning Manager Signo explained that most of the construction impacts are addressed using
  best management practices (BMPs).

Planning Commission Minutes 11.18.25
  Page 3 of 5  6
   Action: Approved 4-0.
  Motion by Commissioner Castaneda to approve the project as
  recommended by staff.
  Seconded by Commissioner Ozaeta.

  COMMISSIONER  VOTE
  Castaneda  Yes
  Ozaeta  Yes
  Valenzuela  Yes
  Vice-Chairperson Prieto  --
  Chairperson Ruiz  Yes

  Planning Manager Signo indicated he would put LAUSD in touch with the applicant in case there
  are questions or concerns during the construction and operation of the project.

  [The Planning Commission recessed at 7:10 p.m. and reconvened at 7:11 p.m. Vice Chairperson
  Prieto rejoined the meeting.]

  9. OPEN SESSION ITEMS
  None.

  10. COMMENTS
  A. Public Comments:
   Mario Dominguez, Jr.
  B. City Staff Comments:
    Planning Manager Signo thanked the Commission for completing the harassment training. He
  mentioned Senior Planner Pelayo would be leaving the City and thanked him for his service.
  He wished the Commission a Happy Thanksgiving.
  C. Planning Commission Comments:
    Commissioner Ozaeta mentioned it would be helpful to reach out and put developers in
  contact with certain community stakeholders. He mentioned residents sometimes don’t
  bring concerns to staff.
    Chair Ruiz indicated that at the last Council meeting, the budget had been discussed. She
  asked if a presentation would be made to the Planning Commission. Staff indicated a
  presentation will be made at the next meeting. Chair Ruiz wished the public happy holidays.

Planning Commission Minutes 11.18.25

  7
   11. ADJOURNMENT
  The meeting was adjourned at 7:22 p.m.

  Respectfully submitted by:

  _________________________________
  Lizette Ruiz, Chairperson
